decision.reason: Evidence and Microsoft Learn indicate fixed asset purchase lines are functionally valid, but FA-072/073 could not expose the option through dropdown/pointer routes and FA-074 Page Inspection did not reach Purchase Line source table. The next distinct UI-first route is a guarded direct Type-cell value entry of Fixed Asset only, with target values still locked.
